# Twins

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/twins.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/twins.py) ·
**Architectures:** 6 · **Pretrained weights:** 6 (6 with ImageNet-1k results)

Twins-PCPVT (Pyramid Vision Transformer with conditional position encodings) and Twins-SVT (spatially separable
self-attention, locally grouped attention alternating with global sub-sampled attention).

## Papers

* [Twins: Revisiting the Design of Spatial Attention in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.13840)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('twins_pcpvt_small.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `Twins` |

| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 4, 8, 16, 32) |

| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | – |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | – |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✗ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Twins` with `twins_svt_small` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
